opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. Applications coordinated by the university Development Office.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research infrastructure. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Grants for new build, refurbishment and equipment to improve access to nationally significant library and archive collections. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Grants for new build, refurbishment and equipment to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new building, refurbishment or equipment) which help people with disabilities live more independently, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards capital projects for charities working in mental health, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK managing listed historic sites (Grade I/II*/Scheduled Monument or equivalent) open to the public.
opportunities.summary: Grants for conservation and restoration work, interpretation and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS in the UK, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and families. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, focused on professional performance with performing arts as the vast majority of its activities.
opportunities.summary: Grants for new build, refurbishment and major equipment to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university in the UK displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment to improve public engagement with science through the history of science. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants for new build, refurbishment and equipment for special schools and colleges supporting pupils with special educational needs at secondary/post-16 level to develop employment and independent living skills. Two-stage application process, two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK with at least two years of exam results and a 'Good' or above inspection rating.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects helping high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges improve teaching of GCSE and A-Level subjects requiring specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). One-stage application process. The 2026 funding round is closed; next round details expected in spring 2027.
